title: China just banned all Western AI models — what happens next

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: China just blocked access to all major Western AI models — and it’s happening now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This move is reshaping the global tech landscape in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The ban targets models like GPT and Bard, cutting off foreign AI tools.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: China is pushing its own models, like the latest Tongyi Qianwen version.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects businesses, developers, and users relying on foreign AI.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway: China is accelerating its tech independence.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think will happen next — will Western models find a way back?
